descriptionModule.briefSummary:
Human genetic studies have shown that loss of function (LOF) mutations in HSD17β13 gene have a protective effect on the progression of alcohol-related and non-alcohol-related liver diseases, such as NASH, without significant adverse phenotypes.

VSA006 is a siRNA drug targeting HSD17β13 mRNA in the liver and reduce the protein level of HSD17β13. Based on phase 1 study results in healthy volunteers and NASH/suspected NASH patients, this phase 2 study is designed to evaluate the efficacy, safety, PK profiles and immunogenicity of VSA006 in Chinese NASH patients.

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase 2 Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of VSA006 in Chinese NASH Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of VSA006 Injection in Chinese Adult Patients With Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH)

primaryOutcomes.description: No Worsening of NASH is defined as no increase in inflammation, ballooning, or steatosis scores in the NAS score.
primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants Achieving ≥ 1 Stage Improvement in Histological Fibrosis with no Worsening of NASH

primaryOutcomes.description: NASH Improvement indicates a reduction by at least 2 points in the NAS score, with at least one-point reduction in ballooning without increase in steatosis score.
primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants Achieving NASH Improvement with no Worsening of Fibrosis

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Compared with placebo, the percentage change in serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT)

secondaryOutcomes.description: measured by magnetic resonance imaging-proton density fat fraction (MRI-PDFF)
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Compared with placebo, the change in liver fat fraction from baseline and liver fat percentage change from baseline

secondaryOutcomes.description: measured by magnetic resonance imaging-proton density fat fraction (MRI-PDFF)
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Compared with placebo, the percentage of participants with a > 30% decrease in liver fat fraction from baseline

secondaryOutcomes.description: NASH resolution was defined as a NAS score of 0-1 for inflammation, 0 for ballooning, and no increase in steatosis score
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants Achieving NASH Resolution with no Worsening of Fibrosis
